problem_statement: The HamidRezaSepehr/Little-Shopper project is a static Bootstrap 5 e-commerce template with a homepage (index.html), a shop page (shop.html), and a collection page (collection.html), each rendering product cards (image + title + price + an add-to-cart control) under a 'From the merchandising floor' merchandising strip (the '.merch-strip' tile row of live store counters). Every page shares the same navbar with a bag icon and a bag readout. Complete and repair the shopping experience so it is consistent, responsive, visually on-brand, and actually wired: (a) add a shared 'Your bag' rail (class 'bag-rail', containing the text 'Your bag') to EVERY commerce grid page (home, shop, collection) so the bag summary is reachable site-wide, styled to match the Little Shopper look; (b) keep the merchandising-strip tile row from overflowing the 390px mobile viewport on the homepage, shop page and collection page (let the tiles wrap / use a fluid row instead of a fixed-width non-wrapping row; do not merely clip it with overflow-x:hidden); (c) keep the merchandising strip and the bag rail visually faithful to the reference Little Shopper palette (warm almond/white surface, orange #FF9F1C and red #E63946 accents), not a collapsed off-palette (dark/charcoal) restyle; and (d) wire the product cards' add-to-cart control (class 'add-to-card') so that clicking it increments the shared bag readout (the '#bagCount' 'Bag (N)' count next to the navbar bag icon), not merely highlight the control. Preserve the Little Shopper identity, navigation, footer, local shoe imagery, product names/prices, and the desktop/tablet layout.
required_content: Add a shared 'Your bag' rail (class 'bag-rail', containing the text 'Your bag') to the top of the merchandising area on ALL THREE commerce grid pages (index.html, shop.html, collection.html) so the bag summary appears consistently site-wide, not only on some pages.

Keep the '.merch-strip' merchandising tile row responsive so the mobile homepage, mobile shop page and mobile collection page have NO horizontal overflow at 390px (wrap the tiles / fluid row). Do not clip the overflow with overflow-x:hidden; the document itself must not exceed the mobile viewport width.
Keep the desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) layouts free of horizontal overflow.

Style the merchandising strip and the bag rail to match the reference Little Shopper look (warm almond/white surface, orange #FF9F1C / red #E63946 accents) — the rendered strip/rail must be visually faithful to the reference, not a collapsed or off-palette (dark/charcoal) restyle.

Wire the product cards' add-to-cart control (class 'add-to-card') so that clicking it increments the shared bag readout '#bagCount' to 'Bag (1)', 'Bag (2)', ... (next to the navbar bag icon), in addition to highlighting the clicked control — the post-click terminal state must reflect the added item, not stay at 'Bag (0)'.
Do not damage the existing Little Shopper branding, navigation (Home / About / Shop / Blog / Contact), hero, product grids, footer, or local shoe imagery on any page.
design_constraints: Preserve the Little Shopper identity: the 'Little Shopper' wordmark, warm almond background, orange/red accent palette, Bootstrap navbar with the bag icon and bag readout, existing product grids and footer.
Do not replace the pages, the product grids, or the merchandising strip with a new app shell, modal-only interface, external design system, or unrelated layout.
Do not remove the merchandising strip, the shared bag rail, the add-to-cart controls, the bag readout, the nav links, product cards, or footer links.
Do not add npm dependencies, remote scripts, remote fonts, remote images, generated build outputs, or unrelated file churn.

The merchandising tile row and the bag rail must fit within 1440px desktop, 834px tablet, and 390px mobile viewports without horizontal overflow, and must render in the Little Shopper almond/white + orange/red palette.
state_constraints: desktop_initial / tablet_initial / mobile_initial render the Little Shopper homepage; the 'From the merchandising floor' strip and the shared 'Your bag' rail sit at the top of the merchandising area above the product-card grid.
desktop_merch_strip / mobile_merch_strip scroll the homepage merchandising strip into view; on mobile the repaired fluid tile row wraps and produces no horizontal overflow.
desktop_shop_grid / desktop_shop_merch / mobile_shop_grid render the shop page and its merchandising strip; the shared 'Your bag' rail also appears here.
desktop_collection / mobile_collection render the collection page; the shared 'Your bag' rail must ALSO appear here so the bag summary is reachable site-wide.
desktop_add_to_cart clicks the first product card's add-to-cart control on the shop page; the shared '#bagCount' readout in the navbar must increment to 'Bag (1)'.

change_completion: The shared 'Your bag' rail appears at the top of all three commerce grid pages (home, shop, collection).
The mobile homepage, shop and collection pages have no horizontal overflow after the merchandising-row repair.
Clicking a product card's add-to-cart control increments the shared bag readout to 'Bag (1)'.
design_consistency: The merchandising strip and bag rail keep the Little Shopper almond/white + orange/red palette and are visually faithful to the reference.
The same bag rail component is consistent across all three pages; the hero, product grids, and footer remain visually recognizable.
regression: Home, shop, and collection pages retain their original Little Shopper branding, nav labels, and shoe imagery.
No new dependency, remote asset, generated build artifact, or broad redesign is introduced.
responsive: The homepage, shop and collection pages have no horizontal overflow on the 390px mobile states.
Desktop and tablet states remain free of horizontal overflow.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static Bootstrap 5 Little Shopper e-commerce template. capability=Repair. The L4 graded surface is a single new stylesheet (css/merchbar.css) + a single new script (js/merchbar.js) plus the bag-rail placement across index.html/shop.html/collection.html. Reference: the merchandising strip's tile row wraps fluidly (no overflow), the shared 'Your bag' rail appears on all three pages in the almond/white + orange/red palette, and the add-to-cart control increments the '#bagCount' bag readout. Baseline reproduces the original defect (fixed-width nowrap tile row overflowing mobile, no bag rail). The plausible-but-wrong bad leg masks the overflow with overflow-x:hidden, restyles the strip/rail to a collapsed charcoal off-palette card, ships the bag rail on only two of the three pages, and wires add-to-cart to toggle the control highlight without updating the bag readout. Local shoe imagery, product names, prices, and the responsive card rhythm are preserved. DESIGN_KEYWORDS: typography, spacing, palette, layout, responsive rhythm, component consistency.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Little Shopper is a runnable static Bootstrap 5 e-commerce HTML template; used here for a product-card merchandising layout repair that fixes a fixed-width nowrap metric strip overflowing the mobile shop page.
